night-focus-red.cssVar: --focus and --danger (night); brightened so the ring holds >=3:1 on every night surface

press-ink.cssVar: --pri-ink (both themes) — the only text color on a red plate

page-white.cssVar: literal on .pagedjs_page / .pe-page, both themes, screen and print

highlighter-specimen.cssVar: literal on .ic-hl underbar and .pe-hl (42% multiply) — a document-ink sample, not chrome red

text-ink-specimen.cssVar: literal on .ic-fc underbar — a document-ink sample, not the grease pencil

display.purpose: The .brand masthead wordmark (serif 700, 22px). The serif italic voices the empty-state title (22px, --tx2) and the PDF bench hint (12px, --tx3).

title.purpose: Serif 400 for modal headers (16px), help-sheet h4 rails (17px), popmenu titles (14px). Never bold.

body.purpose: The chrome default (13px sans on body); doc title 13.5px/600; field labels 12px --tx2.

data.purpose: Teletype mono with tabular-nums: editor (13.2px/1.7), wire ticker (12px), counters with min-width floors (#pgInfo 60px, #zoomPct 40px, #peZoomPct 42px), kbd chips (10px), toolbar text glyphs (11px).

label.purpose: The one micro-caps role: settings group labels (#settings h3, .sgroup summary), 10.5px/700/0.14em uppercase in --tx2 over a 1px --rule underline.

shadows.name: recess-night
shadows.purpose: --recess at night. True physical wells only: the toggle track (.tg), the engaged bench tool (.pe-tool.on), the bench color well (#peColor).

shadows.name: elev-m-night
shadows.purpose: --elev-m at night: popmenus, image menu, outline/lint panels, toasts.

shadows.name: elev-l-night
shadows.purpose: --elev-l at night: modals and the floating drawer (<=1180px).

shadows.name: galley-night
shadows.purpose: .pagedjs_page on the stone: tight contact plus soft ambient — a real offset sheet.

shadows.name: grain-night
shadows.purpose: --grain at night, laid over masthead, toolbar, drawer, statusbar, bench bar — never the stone or the pages.

motion.name: dur
motion.purpose: Feedback speed: hover fills, presses, menus, toggles, drawer slide, toast pop, modal entrances.

motion.name: dur2
motion.purpose: Compositional speed: sitting down at the desk (deskIn), galleys settling (proofIn), the autosave stamp's fade.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: The one easing for named keyframes.

motion.name: deskIn
motion.purpose: Sitting down at a table: #main on load and on return from the bench; #pdfEditor on entry.

motion.name: proofIn
motion.value: opacity 0->1, translateY 5px->0 over var(--dur2); nth-child stagger 60/120/180ms, capped
motion.purpose: Each freshly composed galley (.pagedjs_page / .pe-page) settles onto the stone; Paged.js appends pages as it lays them out so long documents stagger naturally.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: The autosave dot lands like an ink stamp (#saveState.saved::before); the word arrives under it via fade.

motion.name: sortSet
motion.value: translateY 0/-3px/0 over 0.72s loop, bars staggered 0.12s, heights 8/11/9px
motion.purpose: The compositor's hand: three type sorts picked up and set while rendering (#busy). Reduced motion leaves them standing — still a legible mark.

motion.name: modalIn
motion.purpose: A sheet laid on the desk (modals); the scrim uses fade.

motion.name: fade
motion.value: opacity 0->1 (dur for scrims, dur2 for the stamp's word)

motion.name: pop
motion.purpose: A proof slip laid down (toast entrance).

motion.name: toast-out
motion.value: opacity->0, translateY 6px over 0.3s ease-in (class .out; removed 400ms later)
motion.purpose: The slip is taken away — exits drop faster than the entrance rose. Default hold 3400ms; toast(msg, type, ms) takes a per-call duration.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: translateY 6px->0 with fade over 0.16s (dur2 with 0/60/120/180ms stagger on the empty state)
motion.purpose: Laid out line by line: empty state, outline and lint panels.

motion.name: spin
motion.purpose: The only literal spinner: .btnspin inside a busy export button.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: * { animation: none !important; transition: none !important } plus removal of press-down transforms
motion.purpose: Global, absolute kill block in app.css. Nothing survives prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: compose-ticker
motion.value: JS (Paged.js handler in main.js): #pgInfo reads 'p. N…' per page laid out, overwritten by 'N pages' on completion
motion.purpose: Truthful progress in the desk's own language; the counter's min-width floor keeps the zoom controls still.

motion.name: tbrow-scroll-fade
motion.value: JS: scroll listener + ResizeObserver + one post-boot rAF toggle .scroll-l/.scroll-r; 38px CSS mask fade
motion.purpose: Clipped toolbar rows announce hidden tools on whichever edge hides more row.

motion.name: theme-raster-workaround
motion.value: JS (applyUiTheme): translateZ(0) on chrome bars for two rAFs after flipping data-light
motion.purpose: Chromium re-raster workaround only — visually a no-op, not a mechanic. Boot calls applyUiTheme(stored !== 'dark'): the day desk is the default.

breakpoints.name: print
breakpoints.value: print — chrome hidden, only white pages, unscaled, shadowless, animation-free

components.name: Masthead Nameplate
components.description: The serif nameplate over the double ink rule, with the document announcing itself beside it.
components.html: DocForge● Autosaved
components.css: .ds-masthead { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 56px; padding: 0 20px; background: var(--bg, #f4f2ec); font-family: "DocForge Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-masthead::after { content: ""; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 5px; background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--rule, #26261f) 0 2px, transparent 2px 4px, var(--rule, #26261f) 4px 5px); } .ds-brand { font-family: "DocForge Serif", Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; letter-spacing: 0.005em; color: var(--tx, #1a1a17); } .ds-docid { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; padding-left: 16px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #d2cec2); } .ds-doctitle { background: none; border: 0; padding: 2px 4px; cursor: pointer; font: inherit; color: var(--tx, #1a1a17); font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; border-radius: 0; } .ds-doctitle:hover { color: var(--pri2, #a12f23); } .ds-doctitle:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #bb3a2c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-savestate { font-family: "DocForge Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; color: var(--tx3, #64625a); } .ds-stamp { color: var(--ok, #2f6f4f); font-size: 8px; vertical-align: 1px; }

components.name: TO-PRESS Plate
components.description: The one red plate per surface (#btnPdf, #peExport, #cfYes) — the only place the chrome spends its color on a fill.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-press"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V9z"/><path d="M13 3v6h6"/><path d="M12 11.5v6.5m0 0l-2.6-2.6M12 18l2.6-2.6"/></svg>PDF</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-press { background: var(--pri, #bb3a2c); border: 1px solid var(--pri2, #a12f23); border-radius: 0; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--pri-ink, #ffffff); font-family: "DocForge Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.16s ease-out, border-color 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-btn-press:hover { background: var(--pri2, #a12f23); } .ds-btn-press:active { transform: translateY(0.5px); } .ds-btn-press:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #bb3a2c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-press svg { flex: none; }

components.name: Desk Button
components.description: Flat ruled desk furniture: a hairline box does the work a shadow used to do; hover promotes the soft rule to ink.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-desk"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" width="15" height="15" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M13 3H7a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h10a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V9z"/><path d="M13 3v6h6"/><path d="M8.6 12.5l1.3 5 2.1-3.8 2.1 3.8 1.3-5"/></svg>Word</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-desk { background: var(--bg3, #faf9f5); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d2cec2); border-radius: 0; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; cursor: pointer; color: var(--tx, #1a1a17); font-family: "DocForge Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; white-space: nowrap; transition: background 0.16s ease-out, color 0.16s ease-out, border-color 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-btn-desk:hover { border-color: var(--rule, #26261f); } .ds-btn-desk:active { transform: translateY(0.5px); } .ds-btn-desk:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #bb3a2c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-btn-desk:disabled { opacity: 0.55; cursor: default; } .ds-btn-desk svg { flex: none; }

components.name: Ruled Tool Tray
components.description: A toolbar group: 1px hairline tray with transparent 28px plates — mono text glyphs and 1.8-stroke icons — that lift to the fresh sheet on hover.
components.css: .ds-tray { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 1px; padding: 2px; background: var(--bg2, #ece9e1); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d2cec2); border-radius: 0; } .ds-plate { background: transparent; border: 0; color: var(--tx2, #4c4b44); border-radius: 1px; min-width: 28px; height: 28px; padding: 0 6px; cursor: pointer; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 12px; transition: background 0.16s ease-out, color 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-plate:hover { background: var(--bg3, #faf9f5); color: var(--tx, #1a1a17); } .ds-plate:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-plate:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #bb3a2c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-plate b, .ds-plate i, .ds-plate .ds-h { font-family: "DocForge Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; font-style: normal; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-plate b { font-weight: 700; } .ds-plate i { font-style: italic; }

components.name: Printed-Form Field
components.description: A ruled hairline box, not a soft well — focus swaps the soft rule for the grease pencil.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; max-width: 232px; font-family: "DocForge Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { display: block; font-size: 12px; color: var(--tx2, #4c4b44); margin-bottom: 4px; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; background: var(--bg3, #faf9f5); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d2cec2); border-radius: 0; padding: 8px; color: var(--tx, #1a1a17); font: inherit; font-size: 13px; outline: none; } .ds-field-input::placeholder { color: var(--tx3, #64625a); } .ds-field-input:focus { border-color: var(--pri, #bb3a2c); }

components.name: Toggle
components.description: A recessed track — one of the desk's three true wells — with a square knob; checked fills the track with ink. The checkbox is visually hidden, never display:none.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; padding: 4px 0; cursor: pointer; user-select: none; max-width: 232px; font-family: "DocForge Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-toggle-lbl { font-size: 12.8px; color: var(--tx, #1a1a17); } .ds-tg { width: 40px; height: 22px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--bg, #f4f2ec); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.07); position: relative; transition: background 0.16s ease-out; flex: none; } .ds-tg::after { content: ""; position: absolute; top: 3px; left: 3px; width: 16px; height: 16px; border-radius: 0; background: var(--tx3, #64625a); transition: left 0.16s ease-out, background 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-toggle input { position: absolute; opacity: 0; width: 1px; height: 1px; margin: 0; pointer-events: none; } .ds-toggle input:focus-visible + .ds-tg { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #bb3a2c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-toggle input:checked + .ds-tg { background: var(--tx, #1a1a17); } .ds-toggle input:checked + .ds-tg::after { left: 21px; background: var(--bg2, #ece9e1); }

components.name: Instrument Cluster
components.description: Pages · zoom · fit as one ruled counter strip: teletype mono with tabular figures and width floors so ticking numbers never nudge their neighbors.
components.html: 2 pages103%
components.css: .ds-cluster { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 2px; background: var(--bg2, #ece9e1); border: 1px solid var(--line, #d2cec2); border-radius: 0; padding: 2px 6px; height: 26px; font-family: "DocForge Mono", ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace; font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; color: var(--tx3, #64625a); } .ds-pginfo { min-width: 60px; text-align: center; } .ds-zoom { min-width: 40px; text-align: center; color: var(--tx2, #4c4b44); } .ds-sep { width: 1px; height: 14px; background: var(--line, #d2cec2); margin: 0 5px; } .ds-cbtn { background: none; border: 0; color: var(--tx2, #4c4b44); cursor: pointer; font: inherit; min-width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 0; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-cbtn:hover { color: var(--tx, #1a1a17); background: var(--bg3, #faf9f5); } .ds-cbtn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #bb3a2c); outline-offset: 1px; } .ds-fit { font-family: "DocForge Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; padding: 0 7px; }

components.name: Proof-Slip Toast
components.description: An inverted ink slip laid over the work; warnings go on the ochre. Enters with pop (160ms), holds 3400ms by default, then drops out in 300ms — taken away faster than it arrived.
components.html:
Project file saved
Preview error — check your markup
components.css: .ds-toast { display: inline-block; background: var(--tx, #1a1a17); color: var(--bg2, #ece9e1); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 2px; font-family: "DocForge Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: 0 2px 6px rgba(38, 38, 31, 0.12), 0 16px 40px rgba(38, 38, 31, 0.14); margin: 4px; animation: ds-pop 0.16s ease-out; } .ds-toast-warn { background: var(--warn, #7d540d); color: var(--bg3, #faf9f5); } @keyframes ds-pop { from { transform: translateY(8px); opacity: 0; } }

components.name: Running Head
components.description: The one micro-caps role in the chrome: a drawer section label set over its own structural ink rule, like a style sheet's running heads.
components.css: .ds-rail { font-family: "DocForge Sans", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 10.5px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--tx2, #4c4b44); font-weight: 700; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #26261f); padding-bottom: 6px; max-width: 232px; }

narrative.overview:
DocForge is the copy desk at edition time. Text is copy, the preview is the galley, export is going to press. The chrome is a newspaper composing room: newsprint-white working surfaces with a faint paper grain, ink hairline rules doing the work borders and shadows used to do, square corners, ruled trays and printed-form fields, teletype mono instrumentation, and exactly one color spent editorially — grease-pencil red on the TO-PRESS plate, proof marks, and focus. The masthead is a serif nameplate over a double ink rule; the preview deck is the stone, and pages lie on it like galleys. It deliberately refuses the category default of a soft dark editor with one metallic accent: the day desk is what the app boots into, and the dark variant is the same room on the night shift — slate under fluorescents, authored value by value, never an inversion. The document itself is not part of this world: it always renders and prints on white.

The story of the first viewport: the writer sits down at a working desk (nameplate masthead over the double rule), sees their copy typeset live in the galley column (editor and galley as two ruled columns), and sends it to press with the one red plate top right, over a wire-ticker statusbar.
keyCharacteristics: One editorial color (grease-pencil red), spent from a short, closed list — everything else is ink on newsprint.
Flat ruled grammar: 1px hairline trays and printed-form fields; a recess only where something is physically a well.
Two weights of rule with fixed roles: --rule is structural ink, --line is soft furniture. They never trade places.
Square-cornered desk: radii 0 / 2 / 4 (--rc/--rm/--rl), 1px on inner tool plates.
Teletype instrumentation: mono with tabular figures for everything the desk measures, with width floors so counters never nudge neighbors.
Two-speed motion in the press's own vocabulary: --dur 160ms feedback, --dur2 340ms compositional; reduced-motion kills all of it.

rules.name: The Grease-Pencil Rule
rules.body: Red is a closed list, counted from code (src/app.css) — every --pri/--pri2/--focus consumer, 11 rule-sites in 5 roles, and nothing else: (1) the global :focus-visible ring (2px --focus, offset 1; app.css:98); (2) the toggle's proxy focus ring (.toggle input:focus-visible + .tg; app.css:315); (3) the masthead title warming on hover (#docTitle:hover → --pri2; app.css:153); (4) the TO-PRESS plate (.btn.pri: --pri face, --pri2 border, --pri-ink text; app.css:194–196) and (5) its hover to --pri2 (app.css:199) — exactly three instances, one per surface: #btnPdf (studio), #peExport (bench), #cfYes (confirm dialog); (6) printed-form field focus swapping the soft rule for border-color: var(--pri) (app.css:292) and (7) the find-bar inputs likewise (app.css:825); (8–11) the bench proof marks: .pe-edit:hover dashed outline (--pri at 65%), .pe-edit.sel 1.5px outline, the .pe-resize handle fill, and the .pe-drawing marquee (--pri border, 8% fill) (app.css:763–769). Adding a twelfth site requires removing one.

rules.name: The Two Rules Rule
rules.body: --rule (structural ink: nameplate, running heads, ticker, hover borders, the mix-it-yourself ring) and --line (soft furniture: tray/field hairlines, seams, scrollbars) have fixed roles that never blur. Promoting a seam to ink, or softening a structural rule, is a design change, not a restyle.

rules.name: The Night Shift Rule
rules.body: The day desk is the default the app boots into (main.js boots data-light unless the stored preference is "dark"); the night desk is the authored slate variant. Every token ships both values, re-derived — never a numeric inversion (night's --rule goes gray, night's --focus goes brighter).

rules.name: The White Paper Rule
rules.body: Document pages are #ffffff in both themes. Chrome theming must never tint them.

rules.name: The One Micro-Caps Rule
rules.body: There is exactly one uppercase-tracked role in the chrome: the drawer's running heads. No other element may set text-transform: uppercase with tracking.

rules.name: The Teletype Rule
rules.body: Toolbar text glyphs (B, I, H1, Aa, TOC…) are set in the desk's own mono at 11px — deliberately set type, not UI defaults — and every numeric readout uses tabular figures behind a min-width floor.

rules.name: The Flat Ruled Desk Rule
rules.body: New grouping is expressed with a 1px rule (--line for furniture, --rule for structure) on a flat token surface — never with a shadow, glow, gradient, or bevel.

rules.name: The True Well Rule
rules.body: --recess is reserved for controls that are physically wells (a track a knob slides in, a tool socket a plate sits down into). A hover state, a button, a field is not a well.

dos: Do build every new grouping as a flat ruled block: token surface + 1px hairline, --line for furniture and --rule for structure.
Do use mono + tabular-nums with a min-width floor for any readout whose text changes width.
Do give every dialog role="dialog" aria-modal="true", a label, and route it through openOv/closeOv for trap + focus-restore; give live counters role="status".
Do keep icons on the one grammar: 24 viewBox, 1.8 stroke, round caps, currentColor (1.4–1.6 for fine interior detail only).
Do use --dur for feedback and --dur2 for anything that moves the composition; stagger settles at 60ms steps, capped.
Do keep new red inside the Grease-Pencil Rule's closed list, or trade a site out first — and let hover always deepen red, never lighten it.
Do author both desks when adding a token: a day value and a night value, each re-derived for its light (night rules go gray, night focus goes brighter).
donts: Don't put --tx3 text on the day fresh sheet (--bg3) — it misses 4.5:1 there (the kbd chips already stepped up to --tx2). Night --tx3 is safe on all night surfaces.
Don't add shadows, glows, gradients, or bevels to desk furniture — elevation belongs only to galleys on the stone and genuinely floating chrome (popmenus, modals, toasts, the floating drawer).
Don't recess anything that isn't a true physical well (today: the toggle track, the engaged bench tool, the bench color well — that's the whole list).
Don't add a second uppercase-tracked type role, a second editorial color, or a second red plate on the same surface.
Don't hide the toggle checkbox (or any focusable proxy target) with display:none — visually-hidden only.
Don't animate anything outside the named-keyframe grammar, or let any animation survive prefers-reduced-motion.
Don't use raw native widgets where the system has a designed peer (the custom color well, the templates menu) — style them into the desk.
